pages.text: Hold use for $(l)3 seconds$() to return to a $(l)Nether portal$() you went through. With several portals, a menu lets you pick one, or your spawn point. Reusable, with a cooldown.

The stone remembers the last $(l)8 portals$() you arrived through, in every dimension. Use the $(l)x$() button to forget one. A destroyed portal is forgotten automatically. Without any portal, the stone brings you back to your bed or anchor.
